text: {"label": "Behavioral approaches to literacy instruction","definition": "Applying behavior analysis to teaching reading and writing in schools and at home, including conditioned reinforcement for reading, verbal developmental cusps, emergent relations, literacy assessment, and science-of-reading integration.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Covers broad reading and writing repertoires and literacy programs, not specifically oral fluency and comprehension measures, spelling and sight-word acquisition, or general instructional methods like direct instruction."}
